summary: Create a controller with one fresh associated signal.

target.notes: Reuse the existing DOM EventTarget subsystem for listener registration/dispatch; this rule owns AbortSignal-specific state and abort algorithms.

references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § AbortController / AbortSignal

tests.name: fresh associated signal
